title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go, parity fixes and version bump
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR unifies authentication, retry, and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, applies several parity fixes so feature behavior matches across languages, and bumps the SDK package versions. Motivation: inconsistency between SDKs caused confusion for customers and increased maintenance surface. Changes include a single auth credential loader with consistent precedence rules, a shared retry policy DSL (max_retries, backoff, jitter) exposed in each SDK idiomatically, and a streaming helper abstraction to simplify server-sent event handling and reconnect semantics. Also includes small API ergonomic tweaks to align method names and reduce friction when migrating sample code. The change set touches auth plumbing, client factories, integration tests, and documentation snippets. Checklist: - Implement shared auth loader in each SDK - Expose retry config with defaults matching platform SLOs - Add streaming helper with automatic reconnect and backpressure notes - Fix parity issues discovered during cross-language tests - Bump package versions and changelogs - Run full CI and SDK integration suite
commits: feat(sdks): add shared auth loader and precedence rules
feat(sdks): introduce retry policy DSL and defaults
fix(ts): parity for streaming close semantics
fix(go): ensure context propagation in stream reads
